synthetic_provenance.generation_recipe: Derive a bounded diagnostic scenario from one public L0 fact card; synthesize only the ML finding, event-log sequence, illustrative configuration and mission context needed for the task. Preserve the source's certainty and do not reproduce real flight records. The task-type variant changes the requested diagnostic operation while preserving the same source-family boundary and synthetic input provenance.

generated_fields.assumption: Synthetic upstream candidate and score; not an actual model run.
Synthetic event sequence and timestamps are scenario constructs.
Hardware/interface configuration is illustrative, not source-mission configuration.
Mission phase and operating mode are scenario constructs.
A prior rejected-history context is synthetic and used to test non-promotion behavior.

scenario_assumptions: All ML findings, scores, log IDs, timestamps, spacecraft IDs and operational details are synthetic scenario values.
The scenario is designed to test secondary diagnostic synthesis, not raw telemetry detection.
not_simulated: An actual upstream ML model execution

synthetic_provenance.generation_recipe: Construct a new current-evidence comparison grounded in one existing public L0 event family. Synthesize the ML result, independent processed logs, comparison-quality summaries, identifiers, timing and configuration; reconcile scoped current claims without treating historical facts as current diagnostic evidence.

generated_fields.assumption: All ML labels, ranking scores, model and finding IDs, evidence aliases, input scope and run IDs are synthetic; no ML execution occurred.

Every current observation, test outcome, independent comparison, quality-check result, measurement tolerance, timestamp and author/source label is synthetic; these are processed scenario summaries, not actual mission or test records.
Current spacecraft, equipment and configuration identifiers and all comparison scopes are illustrative scenario assumptions, not the source mission hardware.
The operating phase, environmental conditions, comparison windows, test sequence and stated missing checks are synthetic scenario inputs.

scenario_assumptions: All current observations, ML findings, scores, quality assessments, numbers, dates and identities are explicitly synthetic; only the separately marked literature passage is historical source information.
Independent means independent measurement paths or reports within the synthetic scenario, not independently performed physical measurements in this project.
Historical/source evidence is context only; it does not support or contradict a current physical root cause.

The 18% and 82% relative humidity values, same serial/channel checks and matched-profile declarations are new synthetic assumptions, not values or complete equivalence established by the historical source.
not_simulated: Raw telemetry, waveform samples or resistance traces
Actual spacecraft, receiver or laboratory operation logs
Physical inspection, completed repair or verified recovery
